svg.title: Preserve a commit, not your working files
svg.desc: Read-only search and preview. Explicit creation adds a new branch. HEAD, index, and working files stay unchanged. Not a backup of uncommitted work.

g.text: Create a new branch at an existing commit.
Search and preview do not write changes.
No automatic checkout or file restoration.
A branch is not a backup of uncommitted edits or untracked files. Illustrative guide, not terminal output.
